jobs.title: Pharmacy Business Consultant
jobs.description:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

Job Details

This role is in support of Good Neighbor Pharmacy, a Cencora business supporting a network of independently owned pharmacies in the US.

PRIMARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Instruction and Expertise : Serve as an instructor and subject matter expert, providing expert advice, guidance, and feedback on independent pharmacy store operations and business strategies. Offer specialized consultation to other business coaching team members and their clients as needed, including ad hoc independent pharmacy consultative work when available.

- Coordination : Collaborate with assigned Business Coaching Coordinator and business coaching leadership to ensure effective customer coverage and communication.

- Customer Relationship Management : Enhance customer retention and engagement by developing productive business relationships, understanding customers’ strategic objectives, and influencing their decision-making processes to drive profitability.

- Client Interaction : Execute complex processes and engage in client-facing situations by identifying key leverage points within each pharmacy to ensure full commitment from the customer.

- CRM Management : Continuously maintain and update coaching activities within the CRM system to ensure accurate tracking and reporting.

- Report Preparation : Compile pharmacy data to prepare, format, and distribute necessary reports, assisting in the creation of an informative portfolio.

- Results-Driven Approach : Drive results by aligning opportunities with specific customer needs, diagnosing challenges, and supporting the implementation of targeted solutions.

- Program Management : Oversee all aspects of programs to effectively communicate information, instructions, and objectives.

- Operational Analysis : Identify potential weaknesses within pharmacy operations by addressing existing issues in basic functional areas.

- Customer Needs Assessment : Work closely with Business Coaching Coordinator to assess customer needs through various profiles and segment pharmacies accordingly.

- Implementation Guidance : Guide in-store implementations and collaborate with relevant personnel to ensure successful execution.

- Market Knowledge : Develop and maintain a strong understanding of the independent retail pharmacy market, including industry trends, competitive intelligence, and challenges faced by customers.

- Leadership Feedback : Provide leadership with insights on industry intelligence and specific recommendations for managing individual programs, policies, products, and pricing to meet corporate objectives.

- Concept Development : Create and implement new concepts, maintaining awareness of competitive activities and escalating relevant information as necessary.

- Additional Responsibilities : Perform other duties as assigned to support the overall objectives of the Business Coaching program.

- Representation : Represent business coaching programs and solutions at meetings and other events.

- Travel Requirements : Be willing to travel up to 75% or more  (including overnight trips) within the assigned customer base and geographic territory, as well as attend conferences and national, regional,  or local trade conventions.

EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATIONAL REQUIREMENTS:
Requires broad training in fields such as business administration, accountancy, sales, marketing, computer sciences or similar vocations generally obtained through completion of a four year Bachelor’s Degree Program; normally requires a minimum of seven (7) years industry experience and/or directly related and progressively responsible experience.

MINIMUM SKILLS, KNOWLEDGE AND ABILITY REQUIREMENTS:
- Advanced knowledge of the retail pharmacy industry including trends and challenges facing customers Ability to communicate effectively both orally and in writing, and adapt communication style to various audiences 3.Ability to actively listen and influence others with different points of view

- Advanced knowledge and understanding of value, profit, and budgeting

- Advanced knowledge of techniques to improve profitability of a small business

- Proven successful business tactics; credible image in the industry; good marketing skills

- Ability to forecast, set goals, and train others

- Knowledge of product and customer service standards for independent retail pharmacy business

- Advanced analytical and probing skills, including proficiency in related computer programs such as MIcrosoft Office

- Strong presentation skills

- Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills Strong organizational and prioritization skills; attention to detail

jobs.title: General Manager- Brokerage, North America
jobs.description:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

Job Details

This role is in support of Cencora's global logistics and storage services marketed through our World Courier business.

Position Summary
World Courier is seeking an exceptional commercial and operational leader to take on the role of General Manager - Brokerage, North America. This is a high-impact regional leadership role with responsibility for leading and developing the Brokerage service line across North America, with a clear focus on performance, capability, customer outcomes, and growth.

The successful candidate will bring a strong mix of people leadership, commercial acumen, operational credibility, and P&L ownership, gained within a logistics, freight forwarding, specialty logistics, transportation, or broader supply chain environment. This is not intended to be a purely technical customs expert role, but it is important that the individual has developed their leadership experience in a sector where service execution, customer expectations, operational complexity, and regulated processes are central to success.

Candidates may have led a brokerage service line, a freight forwarding operation, a country or regional logistics business, or another specialist service offering within the broader logistics and supply chain sector. What matters most is the ability to lead a strategically important service business, develop teams, improve performance, and drive revenue growth in an environment where operational excellence and compliance both matter.

This role sits at the intersection of commercial growth, operational leadership, service line development, and customs/regulatory oversight. The successful leader will help shape the next phase of growth for Brokerage in North America by strengthening the customer proposition, improving scalability and service consistency, and ensuring the business is positioned to grow effectively across the region.

Key Responsibilities:
- Lead the Brokerage business across North America, with accountability for service line performance, team leadership, operational execution, and future growth.
- Drive the commercial agenda for the business by identifying opportunities to expand revenue, strengthen the customer offering, and increase market impact.
- Bring strong general management discipline to the role, balancing growth ambitions with service quality, operational efficiency, customer expectations, and regulatory requirements.
- Provide visible, credible leadership to teams across the region, building a culture of accountability, engagement, development, and high performance.
- Lead the continued development of the brokerage service line, ensuring it is scalable, competitive, operationally effective, and aligned to broader business priorities.
- Partner closely with Sales, Operations, Customer Service, Finance, Compliance, BI, Training, and global stakeholders to align brokerage priorities with broader business goals.
- Improve service consistency, process effectiveness, and organizational capability across the North America brokerage network.
- Oversee third-party and outsourced brokerage relationships where relevant, ensuring strong performance, effective partnership, and alignment to business standards.
- Maintain a strong framework for customs compliance, audit readiness, and regulatory oversight across the region.
- Perform other duties as assigned.

Candidate Profile / Requirements:

We are interested in senior leaders who have built their careers within logistics, freight forwarding, specialty logistics, transportation, supply chain, or similarly complex service-led operating environments. The successful candidate should bring meaningful experience from within the sector, rather than from a purely generalist commercial or corporate background.

They may come directly from a brokerage leadership role, or from a broader operational or commercial leadership role within freight forwarding, specialty logistics, or another closely related area of the supply chain market. What is important is that they understand how to lead in an environment where customer service, operational execution, commercial performance, and compliance need to work together.

The ideal profile will include:
- A proven track record in senior leadership, general management, or service line leadership within logistics, freight forwarding, brokerage, specialty logistics, transportation, or supply chain.
- Strong experience with P&L management, commercial strategy, and revenue growth in a sector-relevant operating environment.
- Demonstrated success leading and developing high-performing teams in a service-driven, operationally complex business.
- Experience improving service delivery, efficiency, scalability, and performance within a logistics or supply chain setting.
- The ability to build strong partnerships across commercial, operational, and functional stakeholders.
- Confidence operating in a regulated environment where compliance, customer service, and business performance must go hand in hand.
- Strong leadership presence, sound judgement, and the credibility to lead at pace in a visible regional role.

Customs brokerage expertise remains highly relevant, and candidates with direct brokerage leadership experience will naturally be of interest. However, the brief is intentionally broader than a hands-on customs specialist profile and is equally targeted at leaders from adjacent parts of the logistics and supply chain sector who can bring the right mix of sector credibility, commercial strength, people leadership, and operational excellence.

jobs.title: M365 Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Cencora, previously known as AmerisourceBergen, is a leading global pharmaceutical solutions organization centered on improving lives. Ranked #21 on the Global Fortune 500, our team members are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures.
Our Shared Service Center in Lithuania is experiencing rapid growth and we have many diverse and exciting roles in Customer Service, Operations, IT, Finance and HR.  Join us and make a positive impact on human and animal health.

Job Details

Reporting to the Director, Unified Communications, this role leads the operational management, governance, and continuous improvement of Cencora’s Microsoft 365 collaboration and productivity environment. The role is responsible for ensuring reliable, well-governed, and scalable delivery of services such as Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, and related M365 capabilities across the enterprise.

This leader aligns Microsoft 365 operations with IT strategy and business objectives by building standardized support practices, measurable service insights, and repeatable operating processes. The role places strong emphasis on metrics, reporting, automation, and AI-enabled practices to improve efficiency, close knowledge gaps, accelerate issue resolution, and increase the overall impact of the team. Success in this role requires a balance of technical depth, operational discipline, service ownership, and cross-functional partnership with technology, security, compliance, support, and business stakeholders.

Responsibilities:

M365 Operations
- Responsible for the M365 collaboration and productivity experience across all business units, including incident, request, problem, change, and escalation management for supported M365 services

- Lead a team of system administrators responsible for supporting a continually evolving Microsoft 365 environment, including recurring M&A integrations, tenant growth, standardization efforts, and operational change

- Build and maintain reporting dashboards to monitor service health, support trends, adoption, operational performance, and project readiness across the M365 environment

- Manage multiple M365 migration, integration, lifecycle, and standardization efforts in alignment with business priorities, timelines, and operational readiness needs

- Define, document, and maintain M365 administration standards, support processes, governance controls, and operational runbooks

- Support Microsoft 365 governance activities, including policy standardization, lifecycle management, access controls, compliance alignment, and coordination with Information Security, Legal, and Records/Retention stakeholders

- Identify and implement automation opportunities within ServiceNow, M365 administration, reporting, and request fulfillment processes to reduce manual work and improve associate experience

Finance
- Support budget planning and cost management for M365 services, licensing, vendors, and operational improvements

- Identify opportunities to improve service value and reduce unnecessary cost

IT Technology Innovation
- Direct the development and implementation of technologies and processes that improve associate productivity, simplify M365 administration, increase operational efficiency, and enhance the reliability of collaboration services

- Evaluate opportunities to use automation, analytics, and AI-assisted operations to improve service delivery, reporting, request fulfillment, and issue resolution across the M365 environment

Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
- Monitor service performance, support trends, and escalation activity against defined operational expectations.

- Use SLA and service health data to identify improvement opportunities, reduce recurring issues, and improve the associate experience.

Vendor Management
- Support vendor-related decisions, including Microsoft escalation management, licensing impacts, contract input, and service performance discussions for M365 and related collaboration services.

- Review Microsoft and third-party service provider performance, support quality, roadmap alignment, and operational impacts.

- Identify and confirm performance problems, coordinate escalations, and notify contract managers or vendor owners as appropriate.

Resource/Talent Management
- Set team priorities and measurable goals

- Coach and develop administrators

- Support performance management, skill growth, knowledge sharing, and succession readiness

Change Management
- Plan and communicate operational changes related to M365 integrations, standardization, governance changes, and service improvements

- Reduce disruption through stakeholder communication, readiness planning, and support preparation

Education:
- Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, related field, or equivalent work experience.

Work Experience:
- Typically has 5 to 7 years of IT operations, systems administration, or enterprise collaboration services experience, including experience leading teams or operational support functions.

- Requires experience managing teams, leading operational support functions, and building relationships with people at a variety of technical, business, and leadership levels.

- Requires demonstrated ability to launch and deliver one or more IT projects, operational initiatives, or service improvement efforts on time and within budget.

- Experience in a large enterprise Microsoft 365 environment is strongly preferred, including operational support, governance, reporting, automation, migration, and stakeholder management responsibilities.

Skills and Knowledge:
- Technical aptitude on par with a Principal or Level III engineer, with demonstrated ability to learn, evaluate, and operationalize new Microsoft 365 technologies

- Strong working knowledge of Microsoft 365 administration, including Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Intune, Entra ID, MFA, and related security and compliance concepts

- Familiar with modern ticketing and workflow tools, including ServiceNow, as well as administrative dashboards, service health tools, and reporting capabilities within M365

- Able to triage and troubleshoot issues escalated from the M365 operations team, Service Desk, IT partners, business stakeholders, and other escalation sources

- Experience supporting M365 migrations, integrations, lifecycle activities, tenant standardization, and workload rationalization, including cloud-to-cloud and acquisition or divestiture scenarios

- Ability to build dashboards and reports that provide insight into M365 service health, support volume, adoption, compliance readiness, and operational performance

- Understanding of M365 governance, lifecycle management, access controls, licensing considerations, and enterprise compliance obligations

- Experience identifying opportunities for automation, AI-assisted operations, process improvement, and reduction of manual administrative work

- Familiar with enterprise identity and access systems, including Active Directory, Entra ID, MFA, privileged access processes, and related support practices.

Salary: 5861 - 8115 EUR gross monthly

What Cencora offers

We offer a competitive annual bonus, life insurance from Day 1, a best-in-class health insurance package, and up to 6 fully paid benefit days a year. As a Cencora employee, you have the benefit of our referral bonus scheme, our boundless learning opportunities and our global Employee Assistance Program. We have a wonderful office location in Quadrum, equipped with everything you need for a small break at work and fresh snacks at all times. Become part of our purpose-driven, multicultural team now and help us create healthier futures

jobs.description:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

Job Details

Location:
This position is located onsite at our facility in Brooks, KY. There is no option for remote or hybrid work.

This role is in support of Cencora's third party logistics service in the US operating through our ICS business.

This role manages specialized operational activities supporting Cell and Gene Therapy Solutions within an assigned Distribution Center. Responsible for planning, coordinating, and managing highly specialized operations associated with the handling, storage, preparation, and movement of cell and gene therapy products in a complex and highly controlled environment.
This position is categorized as compliance critical and, as such, requires and is assigned specific responsibility for ensuring continual and proper compliance with all division, corporate, client, and regulatory requirements.

- Promotes and leads with Cencora’s purpose and guiding principles and develop a culture of inclusion, equity, and diversity in the Distribution Center.
- Enables and focus on talent development and succession planning in the DC and network wide.
- Directs activities associated with the successful execution of cell and gene therapy operational processes in the Distribution Center; ensures safe, compliant, accurate, and efficient handling of highly specialized and high-value therapies with a strong focus on quality, product integrity, and service excellence. Leads and collaborates across teams to prioritize projects and initiatives, operate with a sense of urgency, proactively solve problems, and drive continuous improvement and standardization.
- Serves as a key operational subject matter expert for Cell and Gene Therapy Solutions and supports internal and external stakeholders on program requirements, operational workflows, and service expectations.
- Acts as a client-facing operational partner, communicating regularly with customers and clients to provide updates, resolve issues, manage expectations, and ensure a high level of service and responsiveness.
- Partners closely with Sales and cross-functional teams to support client needs, drive operational readiness, and ensure successful execution of cell and gene therapy program requirements.
- Responsible for managing specialized product handling and workflow processes while ensuring adherence to product-specific requirements, chain of identity/chain of custody expectations, temperature-controlled handling standards, and other critical quality and compliance measures necessary to maintain product integrity.
- Manages the operational clock with efficient use of labor and hours worked. Supports compliance with all appropriate policies, procedures, safety rules, PPE requirements, security standards, and applicable regulatory requirements; maintains and coordinates all areas of security.
- Monitors performance and productivity measures in the facility and is a change agent for the purpose of maximizing service quality, reducing risk, improving efficiency, and supporting operational excellence.
- Acts as a backup for leadership team as necessary.
- Reviews and monitors standard operating procedures; makes observations and recommends improvements to promote customer experience, efficiency, accuracy, improved service, and lower costs.
- Monitors the performance of staff members to ensure compliance with policies, practices, client requirements, and approved standard operating procedures.
- Supervises associate relations functions including hiring, terminating, performance management, development, and training of warehouse associates. Ensures that Distribution Center equipment and specialized handling environments are maintained and in proper working order.
- Must be willing to work extended hours, split shifts, and some weekends as needed to meet productivity goals and support time-sensitive client and patient-related requirements.
- Establishes and maintains positive working relationships with Distribution Center associates, clients, customers, and internal business partners.
- Performs related duties as assigned.
- Must be relocatable to meet needs of the business.
- Periodic travel may be required based on business need.

#LI-MP1

Education
- Requires broad training in fields such as business administration, supply chain, logistics, life sciences, operations management, or similar vocations generally obtained through completion of a four-year bachelor’s degree program or equivalent combination of experience and education.

Work Experience
- Normally requires a minimum of two (2) years directly related and progressively responsible experience.
- Experience supporting highly regulated, temperature-controlled, specialty pharmaceutical, biologics, healthcare logistics, or other specialized operational environments preferred.

Skills and Knowledge
- Must be relocatable to meet needs of the business.
- Working knowledge of warehouse operations, specialized handling procedures, and quality-focused processes in a regulated environment.
- Ability to communicate effectively both orally and in writing, including frequent interaction with clients, customers, and cross-functional internal partners.
- Strong client relationship and customer service skills.
- Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
- Ability to prioritize client expectations while balancing operational requirements, compliance obligations, and service commitments.
- Ability to work effectively under tight deadlines and manage time-sensitive activities with urgency and accuracy.
- Strong interpersonal and leadership skills.
- Good analytical and mathematical skills.
- Ability to meet deadlines.
- Good decision-making skills.
- Excellent problem-solving skills; ability to resolve issues effectively and efficiently.
- Knowledge of computers to operate effectively with Outlook, PowerPoint, Word, and Excel.
- Comfort working in highly specialized operational environments that may require enhanced personal protective equipment, strict handling procedures, and work in smaller or controlled spaces.
- Strong understanding of the importance of product integrity, compliance, accuracy, and discretion when handling specialized, high-value therapies.
